ledger: Hand | holding first block at 00:00 | resting on second block at 00:09 | repeatedly tilts and steps rightward across blocks from 00:00 to 00:07, then moves left at 00:08
Numbered blocks | two green blocks at 00:00 | eight multicolored blocks at 00:09 | blocks split, spawn, and change colors/numbers as the hand moves across them

findings.description: Blocks spontaneously change color and numerals, and single rigid blocks split into multiple blocks when tilted by the hand without a plausible physical mechanism.
The hand and blocks exhibit a repetitive, rhythmic pulsing motion each second from 00:01 to 00:07 as new blocks materialize.
